calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: The world's schedule and ours. Consensus appears when a month opens; results arrive when it closes.
calendar.moodTip: 0–100. When high, owners hold off on sales and the IPO window narrows. At 70 or more, listings are pulled.
calendar.exposedTip: Touches a holding, deal or watched company
calendar.mineAbout.sale_stage: This stage of the sale ends at month end. Have bids and diligence in before then.
calendar.mineAbout.decision: Past the deadline, the last option is taken.
calendar.mineAbout.covenant: Every holding is tested on leverage and interest cover.
calendar.mineAbout.objectives_review: The chair reviews this year's three objectives. Each one met adds 2 reputation.
calendar.mineAbout.objectives_set: The chair sets three objectives for the new year.
calendar.mineAbout.investment_period: No new investments after this. Time to realize.
calendar.mineAbout.term: The fund ends. Remaining holdings are wound up.
calendar.noConsensus: The consensus appears when the month opens.
calendar.noEffects: In line with expectations. Nothing moved.
calendar.exposedNone: None of our holdings, deals or watched companies
macro.about.fomc: The Fed sets the policy rate. Every loan in the game prices off it. A hawkish surprise widens spreads and lowers US multiples.
macro.about.us_payrolls: Nonfarm payrolls. A strong print lifts US growth and the services cycles.
macro.about.us_cpi: Year-on-year inflation. A hot print tilts the Fed hawkish, widens spreads and lowers multiples.
macro.about.us_gdp: Quarterly growth, annualized. A strong print lifts US growth and multiples.
macro.about.us_ism: 50 is the line. Pushes the industrial components and building products cycles.
macro.about.sloos: Net share of banks tightening standards. Tighter than expected widens credit spreads and shrinks what lenders will write.
macro.about.us_election: Two fictional parties compete. For three months before the vote uncertainty rises and fewer companies come to market. A pro-business win lifts US multiples.
macro.about.us_midterm: Congressional elections. Smaller effect than a presidential vote.
macro.about.ecb: Sets the deposit rate. Tilts multiples for German and French companies. Loan rates still follow the Fed at this stage.
macro.about.ez_hicp: A hot print tilts the ECB hawkish and lowers euro area multiples.
macro.about.ifo: How German firms feel. Pushes euro area growth and the industrial components cycle.
macro.about.cn_activity: Retail sales, year on year. Pushes China growth and the food manufacturing and cold chain cycles.
macro.about.cn_trade: Exports, year on year. Pushes China growth and the industrial components cycle.
macro.about.cn_lpr: The People's Bank sets it with an eye on growth. An unexpected cut lifts China multiples.
macro.about.cn_npc: The National People's Congress sets the year's growth target. Higher than expected lifts China multiples and growth.
macro.about.de_election: A parliamentary vote: the winner takes the government and the chamber. Moves euro area multiples.
macro.about.fr_election: A new president's laws come to a vote some months later.
macro.about.boe: Sets Bank Rate. Tilts multiples for UK companies.
macro.about.uk_cpi: A hot print tilts the BoE hawkish and lowers UK multiples.
macro.about.uk_budget: The size of the fiscal push, as a share of output. The government's platform sets the consensus.
macro.about.uk_election: Parliamentary. Due at most every five years; a snap vote can arrive as breaking news.
macro.about.boj: Moves late from a low rate. A surprise hike cuts Japanese multiples hard.
macro.about.tankan: Large manufacturers' conditions, good minus bad. Pushes Japan growth and the industrial components cycle.
macro.about.shunto: The wage rise. A high one tilts the BoJ toward hiking.
macro.about.jp_election: A chamber vote. A snap lower-house election arrives as breaking news and can change the government.
macro.about.bok: Sets the base rate, watching exports as well as prices. Tilts Korean multiples.
macro.about.kr_exports: Out on the 1st. A lead on world demand. Pushes Korea growth and the industrial components cycle.
macro.about.kr_election: A single five-year term. The new president's laws reach the assembly some months later.
macro.about.kr_general: Sets the assembly majority, and with it the odds on the president's laws.
macro.about.tax_bill: If it passes, every company's tax rate in the bloc changes. Likelier with the majority behind it.
macro.about.trade_act: Changes tariffs and the screening of foreign buyers. Exporters feel it first.
macro.about.regulation_rule: Changes merger review and healthcare rules.
macro.about.tariff_shock: Comes without warning. Tariff drag builds, the target's growth and multiples fall, and the imposer screens foreign buyers harder.
macro.about.geopolitics: Energy jumps and uncertainty spreads to every bloc. Cold chain and food manufacturing are hit first.
macro.about.bank_stress: Credit spreads blow out and lending standards tighten. Pressure to cut rates follows.
